target.label: 8b moonshot · short-context ITL
target.why: the card's measured ceiling: 16.36 GB/token at 149 GB/s, one fp16 matmul across all 32 cores

moved.what: torch-spyre's paged attention ported to Triton and run on the card: batched ~10k decode transforms — 2b conc-8 ITL 1173.0 → 131.4 ms (−89%, 8.9×) and conc-4 550.6 → 84.5 ms (−85%); throughput 6.26 → 24.36 tok/s at conc 8 (now 1.33× AHEAD of torch's 18.3) and 6.55 → 21.68 at conc 4. The sweep's worst square is gone: what was torch 3.16× ahead is now scratchy ahead. Sweep-over-sweep across #732–#1047.

the decode batch's mask reads, carried maximum and ladder-walk proofs: batched mid-context decode improves too — 2b conc-8 ~1k ITL 70.4 → 51.8 ms (−26%, now 1.72× ahead of torch), 8b conc-8 ~1k 181.4 → 148.6 ms (−18%, 1.17× ahead), 8b conc-8 ~123 171.6 → 149.8 ms (−13%, now ahead of torch's 151.6). Every batched decode square is now at parity or ahead of torch. Sweep-over-sweep across #732–#1047.

pipelined decode under scr serve — the next step is submitted while the card computes the current one: rung-1 ITL down at 2b ~123 (43.3 → 39.5 ms) and ~10k (59.1 → 51.6), 8b ~123 (132.5 → 126.0) and ~10k (155.6 → 151.6); 2b fp8 rung-1 ITL 27.3 → 23.2 ms (−15%, now 11.2× torch). Sweep-over-sweep across #732–#1047.
KV pool zeroed with the card's own fill op and prefix/decode rungs built in parallel — startup 13.5 → 10.0 s and 13.1 → 11.9 s; boot-time only, no cell claim.

NAMED: mid-context rung-1 ITL regressed on both models — 2b ~1k 44.8 → 57.7 ms (+29%, torch's lead back to 1.09×) and 8b ~1k 136.6 → 151.8 ms (+11%, now just behind torch). Short-context prefill drifted up: 2b rung-1 ~123 TTFT 63.0 → 77.8 ms (+23%), 2b fp8 rung-1 TTFT 68.5 → 81.2 ms (+19%), 2b conc-8 ~123 TTFT 570.7 → 657.9 ms (+15%), 2b conc-4 ~123 TTFT +13%; 2b conc-8 ~123 throughput fell 124.9 → 116.0 tok/s (now just under torch's 124.9). The paged-attention release bought the ~10k squares with these short/mid-context costs — no gate watched them.

levers.work: the one remaining wide gap, unchanged by this sweep: 2b conc-8 ~123 658 vs 229 ms (torch 2.87× ahead), 8b conc-8 ~1k 2322 vs 790 ms (2.94×), 2b conc-8 ~1k 1067 vs 464 ms (2.30×), 8b conc-4 ~123 920 vs 477 ms (1.93×). Rung-1 prefill is ahead of torch at every bucket; only the batched path lags — prefill scheduling/admission under concurrency is the front.

this sweep's regression: 2b 57.7 ms (torch's lead back to 1.09× from 1.41× ahead-of-torch), 8b 151.8 ms (now 1.02× behind torch). The ~123 and ~10k buckets improved, so the cost is specific to the mid bucket.
126.0 ms at ~123 against the card's ≈110 ms floor (16.4 GB/token at 149 GB/s); now 1.14× ahead of torch at that square.

not built this sweep — 8b fp8 serve is known broken and was excluded by order pending the fix; on 10-21 it stood at 74.2 ms rung-1 ITL (3.5× torch). The 2b fp8 cells this sweep: 23.2 ms rung-1 (11.2× torch), 44.6 ms at conc 8 (17.5×).
2b fp8 short-context ITL 23.2 ms (−15%); the host share between steps shrinks with pipelined decode but is still visible — compile-time CB replay with the next token chosen on the device.

decode: Batched decode closed this sweep: every batched decode square is at parity or ahead of torch — 2b is ahead everywhere (up to 2.82× at conc-8 ~10k), 8b is ahead at conc-8 both buckets and at parity at conc-4 ~123. The paged-attention port (#999) is the mover: the ~10k squares went from torch 2.65×/3.16× ahead to scratchy ahead (1.33× on throughput at conc 8).

Rung-1 decode split by bucket: ~123 and ~10k improved on both models (2b 43.3 → 39.5 and 59.1 → 51.6 ms; 8b 132.5 → 126.0 and 155.6 → 151.6), but ~1k regressed on both (2b 44.8 → 57.7 ms +29%, 8b 136.6 → 151.8 ms +11%) — the mid bucket pays for what the ends gained. Short-context parity is a shared floor: both stacks stream 16.4 GB of fp16 weights per token, and one fp16 matmul on this card streams at most ~149 GB/s, so fp16 at one request bottoms out near 110 ms/token.
prefill: Rung-1 TTFT is ahead of torch at every bucket on both models (2b: 77.8/415.8/6198 vs 111/458/8227 ms; 8b: 176.3/903.3/11120 vs 256.4/946.3/13035 ms), and 2b ~1k and ~10k improved sweep-over-sweep (−12%, −16%). But short-context rung-1 TTFT drifted up (2b ~123 +23%, 2b fp8 +19%) and the batched TTFT cells still trail torch everywhere by 1.1–2.9× — batched prefill is the remaining front.
conc: Every batched cell is the second of two back-to-back reps on one server boot (rep 1 is reliably the slow rep — a property of the harness); both reps are recorded in each cell's note. Decode squares prefer itl_ms (per-request median TPOT under that batch); tok_s is recorded alongside for the concurrency view.

The 8b fp16 batched ~10k squares are unmeasured by design, as on 10-21: the serve refuses at boot — max-model-len 34816 × max-num-seqs 4 needs 545 KV pages against the 16384 MB budget (273 pages); 8b ~10k at this max-model-len fits ≤2 concurrent seqs.
The 8b fp8 legs are absent by order: 8b fp8 serve is known broken and was not built this sweep, pending its fix. The 2b fp8 legs ran and are recorded.

The torch side was not re-run: every torch cell is the 2026-10-21 sweep's value carried verbatim (the reference stack's checkout has not moved since the 2026-10-19 legs — HEAD a63dc01, 2026-10-12), and each cell's note says so. The scratchy side ran the same prompts, buckets, serve flags and rep conventions on nickm5 (10-21 ran on nickm4), so the sweep-over-sweep deltas above are scratchy-side changes on a fixed torch baseline.
fp8: 2b fp8 improved at rung 1 (27.3 → 23.2 ms ITL, −15%, now 11.2× torch) and at conc 8 (49.7 → 44.6 ms, 17.5×); its conc-4/8 throughput drifted down ~4–6% (106.1/145.4 tok/s) with the short-context TTFT costs, still 15–17× torch. The 2b fp8 rung-1 TTFT drifted +19% (68.5 → 81.2 ms) — still 232× under torch's 18.8 s.
The 8b fp8 cells are absent by order: 8b fp8 serve is known broken and was not built this sweep, pending its fix. On 10-21 these cells measured 74.2 ms rung-1 ITL (3.5× torch).
